notes: kuna-fixes cases: classes Vineflower 1.12.0 fails on that a kuna fix decompiles. Each runs in compat and in default mode on the fixture's base map plus `options`; maintained by tests/jvm/kuna_fix_case.py, read by regen.py.

cases.summary: `sweep`, `lastOfHead`, `firstOf`, `itemLength` and `lengthOf`, which use a `Node` nested in the non-generic inner class `Itrs` of the generic class, decompile to their source, `E` mapped to `String` through `Itrs` where the instance is a `TestInnerOfGenericOuter<String>` one; the failure comments and bytecode listings are gone
`objects` and `shapes`, which pass `factory::create` on a `Factory<?>`/`ShapeFactory<?>` receiver to a generic `map`, decompile to their source; the failure comments and bytecode listings are gone

the class, whose synthetic `body` creates the lambda it implements (as the constructor does), decompiles: both sites are written as `this::body`, and `body` stays a method (left out here, as every synthetic method is under `remove-synthetic`); `plain`'s ordinary lambda is still written in place
`create` and `attempt`, whose `catch (Throwable)` handlers start with `if (!flag)`, decompile to their source; `read`, a try-with-resources on a nullable resource, is still rebuilt as one
